# Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview

This is a simple static website project showcasing a retro-themed "Hello World" page with CSS styling and JavaScript animations.

## Tech Stack

- HTML5
- CSS3 (with retro/CRT aesthetic)
- Vanilla JavaScript (no frameworks)

## Code Style

- Use semantic HTML elements where appropriate
- Keep CSS within `<style>` tags in the HTML file for simplicity
- Use vanilla JavaScript — no external libraries or frameworks
- Prefer `const` and `let` over `var`
- Use IIFE or modules to avoid polluting the global scope

## Design Guidelines

- Maintain the retro/terminal aesthetic (green-on-black, pixel fonts, scanlines)
- Animations should be subtle and performant
- Pages should be fully self-contained (single HTML file)
